name: Max drawdown from a curve
summary: Walk a pasted equity or price series and report peak-to-trough max drawdown.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Drawdown_t = (trough − peak) / peak on the running high. Historical statistic only.
